runs.summary: Rerun with nothing changed, 1976 comes out as it did: Carter wins, 297–240–1. The closest state was Oregon, which went to Ford by 0.2 points. Every one of my 100 reruns reproduces it exactly.
howIGotThis: The numbers: the 1970 and 1980 census counts interpolated to 1976 and certified returns; every draw reproduces 1976 exactly before the change.
How sure: I reran it 100 times with different population and parameter draws.

everyone.summary: 68.4 million more adults vote. Oregon, Virginia flip, but Carter still wins, 315–222–1. The closest call is California, which holds for Ford by 0.2 points. Ford wins in 0 of 100 draws.
assumptions: Every adult votes. Non-citizens choose like naturalized citizens of their state and sex; Black Southerners like Black voters outside the South; everyone else as their group did in 1976.
howIGotThis: What changed: Every adult can vote, and turns out.
